verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with configurable call flows (ring orders, phone menus, Sona) and webhooks, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no evidence of version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. The documented date-based versioning applies to the Public API contract, not to user automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
